entries.title: Job 25:1
segments: ¶Then Bildad the Shuhite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 25:2
segments: "Dominion and fear [belong] to Him; He makes peace in His high places.

entries.title: Job 25:3
segments: Is there any number to His armies? Upon whom does His light not rise?

entries.title: Job 25:4
segments: How then can man be righteous before God? Or how can he be pure [who is] born of a woman?

entries.title: Job 25:5
segments: If even the moon does not shine, And the stars are not pure in His sight,

entries.title: Job 25:6
segments: How much less man, [who is] a maggot, And a son of man, [who is] a worm?"
